The '''Gacerian system''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Star system/Legends|system]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], which contained the following [[Planet/Legends|planets]]:

*1 [[Tun]]: no [[Moon/Legends|moons]]
*2 [[Wei]]: no moons
*3 [[Alc]]: 1 moon.
*4 [[Gacerian]]: 2 moons
*5 [[Tytun]]: 8 moons
*6 [[Rue]]: no moons
